diagrams.title: **No magic
diagrams.caption: **No magic.** Agent Builder is a Strands agent with a big toolbox and a good system prompt. It just does the setup for you.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 260" aria-label="Agent Builder under the hood: it registers its built-in tools with Strands, sets up a Bedrock model tuned for tool use, sends your request to the model, which decides which tools to call; Strands executes the tools and returns results; the model writes the final answer." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
      <rect x="20" y="40" width="190" height="120" rx="16" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="36" y="74" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:16px;font-weight:700">1 Register</text><text x="36" y="102" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">its built-in tools</text><text x="36" y="124" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">with Strands</text>
      <path d="M210 100 H234" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
      <rect x="238" y="40" width="190" height="120" rx="16" class="brain" style="fill:#FFF1CC;stroke:#B07600;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="254" y="74" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:16px;font-weight:700">2 Set up model</text><text x="254" y="102" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">on Bedrock, tuned</text><text x="254" y="124" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">for tool use</text>
      <path d="M428 100 H452" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
      <rect x="456" y="40" width="190" height="120" rx="16" class="usr" style="fill:#E8EAF1;stroke:#4A5170;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="472" y="74" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:16px;font-weight:700">3 Your request</text><text x="472" y="102" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">goes to the model,</text><text x="472" y="124" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">which picks tools</text>
      <path d="M646 100 H670" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
      <rect x="674" y="40" width="190" height="120" rx="16" class="agent" style="fill:#19203F;stroke:#19203F;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="690" y="74" class="t on-agent" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:16px;font-weight:700">4 Strands runs</text><text x="690" y="102" class="ts on-agent" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">the tools, returns</text><text x="690" y="124" class="ts on-agent" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">results to the model</text>
      <path d="M864 100 H888" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
      <rect x="892" y="40" width="190" height="120" rx="16" class="brain" style="fill:#FFF1CC;stroke:#B07600;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="908" y="74" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:16px;font-weight:700">5 Model writes</text><text x="908" y="102" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">a natural-language</text><text x="908" y="124" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">answer</text>
      <path d="M987 162 Q987 230 560 230 Q160 230 133 166" class="ln dash" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none;stroke-dasharray:7 7"></path>
      <text x="560" y="200" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">the same agent loop you've been using all along</text>
    </svg>
